name: calendar
useFor: Use for choosing a day, several days or a range in place (scheduling an automation, a usage report's period). mode is single, multiple or range, with selected and onSelect; disabled takes dates, ranges, before or after, days of the week or a function; numberOfMonths shows months side by side; captionLayout="dropdown" adds month and year selects for far dates. In a form field use DatePicker. Dependency free; dates are local Date objects.
constraints: Gaps between days in a range
source: Extrapolated from the Hoplite website: the Chakra Petch title, Kode Mono labels (.label), the compact ghost keys (.hn__top), the hover wash and the 32 percent line
title: Calendar
description: A month grid: a Chakra Petch month title between compact ghost hexagon keys, Kode Mono weekday labels and 36px square days that meet edge to edge; today in a quiet frame, a chosen day filled ink, the days of a range on the hover wash between two ink ends.
